name: JE_PT_SAFT_GL_DATA
description: JE_PT_SAFT_GL_DATA contains the data required from Oracle Fusion Subledger Accounting and Oracle Fusion General Ledger modules to be used by SAFT

columns.name: GL_DATA_ID
columns.description: Unique data identifier

columns.name: JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal entry header defining column

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Journal entry category

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Journal line entered currency

columns.name: DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Journal entry effective date

columns.name: GJH_LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Journal header who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Journal entry header name

columns.name: POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which journal entry header was posted

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Unique period number within accounting calendar year.

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting period type. Example are Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly.

columns.name: JE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Journal entry line number

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Journal entry line description

columns.name: GLL_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Journal line who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: GLL_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Journal lines who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: GL_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Natural account segment

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of accounting entry.

columns.name: AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Number that is associated with each subledger journal entry line.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Debit amount in ledger currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Credit amount in ledger currency.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Integer).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the ESS job. ''WIP'' for on going request and ''C'' for completed request

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the customer site associated with the customer. This must be a ''BILL_TO'' site.
